what_happened.line: The School Building Committee approved the design firm's contract amendment after a wrong attachment figure was corrected and the fee proposal was used.
The committee also approved the first contract amendment, covering the project manager and design contracts.
The owner's project manager will send the construction manager a notice to proceed with the next preconstruction phase; no vote was taken.
Members agreed to meet on the second Wednesday of each month at 6:30, with the next meeting on February 12th and the location to be determined.
A list of trade and non-trade packages will be given at the next meeting so local firms can prepare to bid.

why_it_matters: The amendments commit project money for the design phases of the new school, which is paid for through the debt exclusion residents approved, so they bear on the final cost to taxpayers.
Trade packages go to the lowest qualified bidder by statute, so local contractors are not guaranteed the work, and the cost of bidding is set by that rule rather than by local preference.
watch_next: The February 12th committee meeting, where the list of trade and non-trade packages is due and the location is to be set.
Separate not-to-exceed proposals for survey, geotechnical, hazardous materials and wetlands work, which sit outside the lump sum.
